description: 1. Run `gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner` to confirm the repo is `openforge/dbmigrate`. 2. Extract keywords from the bug description (connection pool exhaustion/timeout). Strip SKILL.md-specified filler words (the, a, is, for, with, this, that, when, not, but, and, from) to form clean search terms. 3. Run `gh search issues --repo openforge/dbmigrate 'KEYWORDS' --limit 5 --json number,title,state,comments` — this is mandatory, not optional. 4. ALSO run `gh search prs --repo openforge/dbmigrate 'KEYWORDS' --limit 5 --json number,title,state,comments` — both searches are required by the skill. 5. The issue search returns #342 (open, 8 comments), #287 (open), #201 (closed); the PR search returns #355 (open). 6. Open and read at minimum `gh issue view 342 --repo openforge/dbmigrate` since it is the primary match. Recognize it covers exactly the reported topic (pool exhaustion under high concurrency). 7. Per the SKILL.md decision table: an existing open thread covers the exact topic → recommend commenting there instead of creating a new issue. 8. Write `triage_report.md` listing found threads in the prescribed format (#NUMBER — TITLE (N comments, state)) and clearly recommending the user comment on #342 rather than open a new issue, while also noting PR #355.
